question: Put these 1975-1977 organizational readjustment events in order.
reference: Jehovah's Witnesses—Proclaimers of God's Kingdom, Chapter 9, p. 105-106

items: December 4, 1975: the Governing Body approves the readjustment
January 1, 1976: six administrative committees take over Society activities
February 1, 1976: Branch Committees replace single branch overseers
June 8, 1977: N. H. Knorr dies

question: Put these Bible-education-program milestones in order.
reference: Jehovah's Witnesses—Proclaimers of God's Kingdom, Chapter 9, p. 109

items: 1977: all elders attend a Kingdom Ministry School course
December 1977: the Pioneer Service School is inaugurated
1984: ministerial servants begin attending the Kingdom Ministry School
Fall 1987: the Ministerial Training School opens

question: Put these chronologists' contributions to identifying 1914 as a significant date in order.
reference: Jehovah's Witnesses—Proclaimers of God's Kingdom, Chapter 10, p. 134

items: 1823: John A. Brown calculates the "seven times" of Daniel as 2,520 years
1844: E. B. Elliott points to 1914 as a possible end date
1849: Robert Seeley handles the matter similarly
1875: N. H. Barbour identifies the start of the Gentile Times via Zedekiah's removal

question: Put these steps in how The Watch Tower identified its editor/writer over the decades in order.
reference: Jehovah's Witnesses—Proclaimers of God's Kingdom, Chapter 10, p. 143

items: C. T. Russell's name is listed as editor in nearly every issue
December 1, 1916: the names of an editorial committee are listed instead
October 15, 1931: even the committee list is removed, replaced by Isaiah 54:13
1942: it becomes the general rule not to name any individual writer

question: Put these events of the 1931 convention's new-name announcement in order.
reference: Jehovah's Witnesses—Proclaimers of God's Kingdom, Chapter 11, p. 154-155

items: The letters "J W" appear on the convention program, unexplained
On Sunday, July 26, Rutherford delivers "The Kingdom, the Hope of the World"
Later that day, Rutherford explains why a distinctive name is needed
The resolution adopting the name Jehovah's witnesses is read to loud applause

question: Put these developments in the "great crowd" doctrine in order.
reference: Jehovah's Witnesses—Proclaimers of God's Kingdom, Chapter 12

items: The first volume of Vindication is published (1931)
The Jehu and Jehonadab account is applied to an earthly-hope class (1932)
Bethel brothers discuss unanswered questions about the great multitude (early 1935)
The Washington, D.C. convention identifies the great crowd as earthly (May 31, 1935)

question: Put these Watchtower articles addressing sexual morality in order.
reference: Jehovah's Witnesses—Proclaimers of God's Kingdom, Chapter 13, p. 174

items: November 1879: the Watch Tower first draws attention to the Bible's standard against fornication
March 1, 1935: The Watchtower states that field ministry gives no license for immoral conduct
May 15, 1941: "Noah's Day" discusses sexual debauchery at length
July 1, 1942: a further article condemns conduct out of line with Bible standards

question: Put these blood-related Watch Tower publications and policies in order.
reference: Jehovah's Witnesses—Proclaimers of God's Kingdom, Chapter 13, p. 181-182

items: December 15, 1927: The Watch Tower first discusses the sanctity of blood
December 1, 1944: The Watchtower specifically mentions blood transfusions
1961: the booklet Blood, Medicine and the Law of God is published, and disfellowshipping begins
1977: the booklet Jehovah's Witnesses and the Question of Blood is published

question: Put these tobacco-policy milestones in order.
reference: Jehovah's Witnesses—Proclaimers of God's Kingdom, Chapter 13, p. 176-177

items: 1895: the Watch Tower first comments on tobacco use, citing 2 Corinthians 7:1
March 1, 1935: headquarters staff and Society representatives are barred from tobacco use
July 1, 1942: the prohibition is extended to all appointed congregation servants
1973: smokers are no longer accepted for baptism

question: Put these early-life milestones of Frederick W. Franz in order.
reference: Jehovah's Witnesses—Proclaimers of God's Kingdom, Chapter 9, p. 105-106

items: September 12, 1893: Frederick Franz is born in Covington, Kentucky
1899: the Franz family moves to Cincinnati
1911: Frederick graduates high school and enters the University of Cincinnati
November 30, 1913: Frederick Franz is baptized

question: Put these doctrinal-understanding adjustments discussed in Chapter 10 in order.
reference: Jehovah's Witnesses—Proclaimers of God's Kingdom, Chapter 10

items: 1925: "Birth of the Nation" identifies 1914 as the Kingdom's birth in heaven
1931: Isaiah 54:13 replaces the editorial-committee listing in The Watch Tower
1962: "the superior authorities" of Romans 13 are understood to be secular rulers
1963: "Babylon the Great" is understood to be the entire world empire of false religion

question: Put these blood-transfusion legal cases described in Chapter 13 in the order the years occurred.
reference: Jehovah's Witnesses—Proclaimers of God's Kingdom, Chapter 13, p. 183

items: 1975: Danish parents are pursued by police over their son's transfusion
